# visionary_alert_silence (Resource)

A silence holds back notifications for matching alerts: a maintenance window (once) or quiet hours (weekly). Matchers are ANDed; none matches every alert.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Quiet hours: no info or warning notifications on weeknights.
resource "visionary_alert_silence" "nights" {
  name       = "Quiet nights"
  severities = ["info", "warning"]

  weekly = {
    days = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    from = "22:00"
    to   = "07:00"
    tz   = "Europe/Berlin"
  }
}

# A maintenance window for one rule.
resource "visionary_alert_silence" "upgrade" {
  name     = "Database upgrade"
  rule_ids = [visionary_alert_rule.slow_checkout.id]

  once = {
    starts_at = "2026-12-05T22:00:00Z"
    ends_at   = "2026-12-06T02:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Default true.
- `labels` (Map of String) Only rules with these labels.
- `once` (Attributes) A window between two times. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--once))
- `rule_ids` (List of String) Only these rules (ids).
- `series` (String) Only this series (instance, check, host or container); * is a wildcard.
- `severities` (List of String) Only these severities.
- `weekly` (Attributes) Quiet hours on some days of the week; a to before from spans midnight. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--weekly))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id Visionary gave it.
- `state` (String) active, scheduled, ended or disabled, when last read.

<a id="nestedatt--once"></a>
### Nested Schema for `once`

Required:

- `ends_at` (String) RFC 3339 end, at most 90 days later.
- `starts_at` (String) RFC 3339 start.


<a id="nestedatt--weekly"></a>
### Nested Schema for `weekly`

Required:

- `days` (List of Number) Days, 0 (Sunday) to 6.
- `from` (String) HH:MM.
- `to` (String) HH:MM.

Optional:

- `tz` (String) IANA time zone, such as Europe/Berlin (default UTC).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is the number Visionary shows, for example in the API.
terraform import visionary_alert_silence.example 12
```
